summary: Putting custom modules and plugins in a collection makes them usable in any playbook or role and easy to share via Galaxy; the rest of the page covers standalone alternatives.
questions: What's the best way to make my custom modules usable from any playbook?

answer_card.title: Local modules via collections
answer_card.answer_md: Create a collection: its modules and plugins work in any playbook or role and can be shared through Ansible Galaxy at any time.
